Constraint consistency: has_matching_key is never true alongside target_picked_up, so no interference; the machine never rewards events that cannot occur in the wrong order. Predicate-only event set matches the propositions table; no persistent/event confusion arises since has_matching_key is a condition read each step. Compact: 4 states, minimal for the two-occasion requirement.
